# id | path | expires (YYYY-MM-DD) | issue | reason
#
# Each row is either kept on purpose (the reason says why the finding is
# true by design; #81, renewed at expiry after a new look) or deferred
# (the fix is more than a config change; #84, with a short expiry so
# the gate asks again). Fix a deferred finding and delete its row. A new row
# needs a real reason, not the Trivy title.
AWS-0031 | aws-ecr-repository/main.tf | 2027-10-31 | luthersystems/tf-modules#81 | Kept on purpose: callers may push moving tags (latest, branch tags); immutable tags would fail those pushes, so a caller opts in, not the module default.
AWS-0039 | eks-vpc/eks_master.tf | 2027-01-31 | luthersystems/tf-modules#84 | Deferred: envelope encryption of secrets needs a KMS key per cluster and cannot be turned off once on, so it is its own reviewed change, not a baseline cleanup.
AWS-0040 | eks-vpc/eks_master.tf | 2027-10-31 | luthersystems/tf-modules#81 | Kept on purpose: the public endpoint is the public_api variable, which callers set; callers that need it public narrow it with public_access_cidrs.
AWS-0041 | eks-vpc/eks_master.tf | 2027-10-31 | luthersystems/tf-modules#81 | Kept on purpose: public_access_cidrs defaults to 0.0.0.0/0 so callers that do not set it see no change; callers such as ui-infrastructure set their own CIDRs.
AWS-0053 | aws-sftp/transfer_server.tf | 2027-10-31 | luthersystems/tf-modules#81 | Kept on purpose: the NLB is the SFTP server's public endpoint for partners outside our network.
AWS-0104 | eks-vpc/eks_master.tf | 2027-10-31 | luthersystems/tf-modules#81 | Kept on purpose: the control plane and nodes reach AWS APIs, ECR and image registries over the internet; a narrower egress rule breaks node joins and pulls.
AWS-0104 | eks-vpc/eks_workers.tf | 2027-10-31 | luthersystems/tf-modules#81 | Kept on purpose: the control plane and nodes reach AWS APIs, ECR and image registries over the internet; a narrower egress rule breaks node joins and pulls.
AWS-0130 | eks-vpc/eks_workers.tf | 2027-01-31 | luthersystems/tf-modules#84 | Deferred: requiring IMDSv2 changes the launch template, which rolls every node, and pods that still call IMDSv1 break; it needs a rollout plan per cluster.
AWS-0132 | aws-access-log-bucket/s3_buckets.tf | 2027-10-31 | luthersystems/tf-modules#81 | Kept on purpose: ALB access logs can only be delivered to a bucket encrypted with SSE-S3, not SSE-KMS.
AWS-0132 | aws-cf-reverse-proxy/main.tf | 2027-10-31 | luthersystems/tf-modules#81 | Kept on purpose: a CMK on the access log bucket needs a key policy that admits CloudFront log delivery, for logs that are not sensitive; SSE-S3 already encrypts them.
AWS-0132 | aws-s3-bucket/s3_buckets.tf | 2027-10-31 | luthersystems/tf-modules#81 | Kept on purpose: the bucket uses SSE-KMS with the caller's aws_kms_key_arn; Trivy flags only the empty default, which falls back to the AWS managed key.
AWS-0164 | aws-sftp/transfer_server.tf | 2027-10-31 | luthersystems/tf-modules#81 | Kept on purpose: these are the public subnets that hold the internet-facing SFTP NLB and its Elastic IPs.
AWS-0164 | eks-vpc/network.tf | 2027-10-31 | luthersystems/tf-modules#81 | Kept on purpose: public IPs follow the public_worker_ip variable (default true, for clusters with no NAT gateway); changing the default would cut existing nodes off the internet.
AZU-0012 | az-blob-bucket/bucket.tf | 2027-10-31 | luthersystems/tf-modules#81 | Kept on purpose: the default action is Deny whenever a subnet_id is given; Allow is only the no-VNet case, where Deny would lock every client out.
